{{Quote|You cannot, cannot. We have kept it, safe, unsullied since we were entrusted with it.|Steward of the vaults|<ref name="Han Solo and the Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Steward''' was the overseer of the treasure vaults of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].

==Biography==
The Steward was a tall, broad-shouldered man with a full head of white hair and matching forked beard. He spoke with a hearty and charming voice. He was one the elite [[Survivors (Dellalt)|Survivors]] whose duty it was to protect the treasure of Xim at all costs. So, once the secret was out, it was he who ordered the [[Mission Commander]] to awaken the [[Guardian Corps]] to eradicate [[J'uoch's mining camp]], believing the crew and passengers of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] already dead. After the gates of the vaults were breached, near the end of the recovery [[Mission to Dellalt|mission]], the Steward was shot and killed by [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]] while trying to defend the treasure to the last. He, like all Survivors, was [[Hypno-imprinting|hypno-imprinted]] during childhood.
